verdicts.reason: A splits inline parsing into small named matcher functions driven by a rules list and renders blocks from plain data, so adding or changing a rule is a local edit, whereas B packs all inline logic into one long loop with numeric level flags and interleaves block rendering with the parsing loop via a closure.

Version B splits inline parsing into small per-rule functions driven by a readable rule list with named options, and separates block accumulation from block rendering, whereas A packs everything into one long loop keyed on opaque numeric level constants.
